title: Settlement Basis: What a Keyturn Host Protection Plan Accepts on an Appraised Loss
content:
An appraisal settles what the marketplace accepts on a loss under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan and books that money as owed to the host.

### The cost accepted

What the plan accepts on a loss is the cost the appraisal establishes, which the marketplace takes as the largest amount a claim stands opened at on the enrolment, accepted at the marketplace's unmanaged-repair rate of 80 percent and with nothing taken off for the condition of the parts replaced. The accepted amount is capped once, by the plan's overall physical damage limit, the ceiling for the kind of loss having already been applied when the claim was opened.

### Loss of use

Loss of use is paid at the plan's daily sum for the days the vehicle stands off the road, never for more days than the plan's longest period and never for fewer than none, and the days are counted from the day the loss is recorded on the most recently opened claim to the day of the appraisal with neither end day counted.

### The valuation fee

No share of the marketplace's out-of-network valuation fee, which is 240, is carried by the host.

### The figures each plan publishes

| Plan | Physical damage limit, USD | Loss of use, USD per day | Loss of use, longest period in days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 45000 | 0 | 0 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 70000 | 35 | 7 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 100000 | 50 | 10 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 150000 | 65 | 14 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 200000 | 85 | 21 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 300000 | 120 | 30 |

### The order

The order is fixed: the cost established is taken first at the repair rate the workshop record calls for, the betterment share is then taken off the figure that step leaves and that figure is rounded half up to two decimal places, the plan's overall physical damage limit is applied to the rounded figure, the loss-of-use sum is then added to it, the host's share of the valuation fee is taken off last, and the accepted amount is rounded half up to two decimal places on that final result. Every figure the plan publishes, its overall physical damage limit, its daily sum for loss of use and its longest period for it among them, is read from the plan the enrolment is written on.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

A vehicle written on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan, where the largest amount a claim stands opened at on the enrolment is 10000, appraised 6 days after the day the loss is recorded on the most recently opened claim. The cost is taken at 80 percent, giving 8000, which is inside that plan's physical damage limit of 100000. The days off the road, with neither end day counted, are 5, and at that plan's daily sum of 50 the loss-of-use sum is 250, which is inside its longest period of 10 days. Nothing is taken off for the valuation fee, and the accepted amount is 8250.00.
